Two folios of parchment, about 230 by 220, columns of fairly free, 1 and 2r of 2l, the text of 200 by 65 mm, that of 100 mm., with 33 to 36 lines per column. The script is a fairly formal square Palestinian type in dark brown ink. Some parts were retracted in black, particularly obliterating the pointing, particularly on the lower half of fol. 2r. The Palestinian accent signs, were added in the ink varying from dark brown to red brown. Subsequently Tiberian pointing was added in a similar, generally paler ink. The pointing shows considerable divergence from: e.g. qames and segol and rare, approximately written in a position different from that of hkh.
Fragment of a leaf of parchment, originally about 255 by 230, now fragments of a leaf of parchment. The text is written in Tiberian handwriting in a regular Palestinian type or column. The manuscript is in the library of the British Museum, and is available for inspection in the Reading Room. It is already published in JTS MS 582, see Lamb. 5:22. It may belong to the same system as hkh.
